author: __Jeebus__
body: I recently contacted my friend, "ASFLUFFY710", and it turns out he does play every once in a while. If there is some way you want me to prove that he is not my alt, please let me know. Not sure if he plays Nebula anymore, but if he does, please know that it is not me.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey vector,

He was banned a few months ago for hacking. It would be much better if he could write his own appeal if he'd like to be unbanned, which would work in your favor as well. You've already been unbanned, and you will not be banned again for connections to ASFLUFFY710 unless clear proof of the account being yours is provided.

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
